info.title: CRM API
info.summary: Contract for the CRM backend (Express) and the Angular web app.
info.description:
Hand-written OpenAPI 3.1 contract. One file per area under `paths/` and
`schemas/`; shared parts live in `common.yaml`.

Error answers always use `ErrorResponse`. Texts are German.

get.description:
Public. Answers 200 while the process runs. The route lives inline in
`app.ts`, not in a router file.

post.summary: Log in with user name and password
post.description:
Starts a new session (the old session id is replaced) and sets the
cookie `JSESSIONID` (httpOnly). Missing, empty or unknown credentials
answer 401 `Ungültige Anmeldedaten`. The contract does not validate the
body.

Set-Cookie.description: Session cookie `JSESSIONID`: HttpOnly, Path=/, Expires (24 h maxAge), SameSite=Lax, plus Secure when NODE_ENV=production.

post.description:
Destroys the session and clears the cookie `JSESSIONID`. Always answers
200 `{}`, also without a session.

post.summary: Log in by user name only (test helper)
post.description:
Exists only in development and test. In production the route answers 404
`{status, message}`. No password check. A missing `benutzername` answers
401 `benutzername required`; an unknown user answers 401
`Benutzer nicht gefunden`. Sets the cookie `JSESSIONID`. The contract does
not validate the body.

Set-Cookie.description: Session cookie `JSESSIONID`: HttpOnly, Path=/, Expires (24 h maxAge), SameSite=Lax, plus Secure when NODE_ENV=production.

get.summary: Claim the oldest open task of a source
get.description:
Sets the oldest `OPEN` task of `source` to `IN_PROGRESS` and answers it.
`source` is required and checked in code (400 when missing or not an
enum value). Answers 204 without body when no task is open.
A wrong agent token never falls through to a session: it answers 401. Needs `AGENT_API_TOKEN` to be configured, also for the loopback bypass.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Task source. Checked in code, not by schema validation.

204.description: No open task for this source.

get.summary: Count tasks per source and status
get.description: One entry per source. All four sources always appear.

post.summary: Set every task back to OPEN
post.description: Clears `comment`, `pickedUpAt` and `resolvedAt` on all rows. The body is optional and ignored.

`OPEN` → `IN_PROGRESS`. Answers 409 when the task is not `OPEN`. The body is optional and ignored.
A wrong agent token never falls through to a session: it answers 401.

Sets `REJECTED` with the comment. Answers 409 when the task is already `DONE` or `REJECTED`.
A wrong agent token never falls through to a session: it answers 401.

Sets `DONE` with an optional comment. Answers 409 when the task is already `DONE` or `REJECTED`.
A wrong agent token never falls through to a session: it answers 401.

get.description:
Agent token, loopback bypass or admin session. A non-admin session answers 403.
A wrong agent token never falls through to a session: it answers 401.
Optional filters `source` and `status`. A value outside the enum answers 400.

Atomic claim: the oldest `TODO` + `AI` ticket becomes `IN_PROGRESS` (sets `pickedUpAt`).
Optional `type` filter. Answers 204 when no ticket matches.
Agent token or loopback only. A session cookie is not accepted, because this GET changes state (CSRF).
A wrong agent token answers 401 and never falls through to a session.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Ticket type filter. An unknown value answers 400 `Ungültiger Ticket-Typ: <value>`.

get.description:
Five columns, each an array of list items (with `commentCount`), oldest first.
Any logged-in session (no admin needed) or an agent token.
A wrong agent token answers 401 and never falls through to a session.

post.description: Deletes all tickets and comments, then re-seeds the workshop tickets. Admin session only.

get.description:
Paged list of list items (with `commentCount`). Admin session only.
Filters `type`, `status`, `owner`: an unknown value answers 400 (`Ungültiger Ticket-Typ: <value>`, `Ungültiger Status: <value>`, `Ungültiger Eigentümer: <value>`).

post.description:
New ticket starts as `owner=HUMAN`, `status=DEFINITION`, without comments.
An unknown `agentTaskId` answers 400 with a field error on `agentTaskId`.
Agent token, loopback or admin session.

get.description: Ticket with comments. Any logged-in session (no admin needed) or an agent token.

patch.description:
Moves the ticket to any column. Into `DONE` sets `solution=DONE` and `resolvedAt`. Out of `DONE` clears both. Owner never changes.
Agent token, loopback or admin session.
Changes the owner only. `AI` keeps the ticket in `DEFINITION`. Agent token, loopback or admin session.

post.description:
Claims by id: `TODO` + `AI` becomes `IN_PROGRESS`. Any other state answers 409.
Agent token, loopback or admin session.

`IN_PROGRESS` becomes `DONE` with `solution=DONE`. Any other state answers 409.
An optional `comment` is stored as an `AGENT` comment. Agent token, loopback or admin session.

`IN_PROGRESS` becomes `ON_HOLD`, owner `HUMAN`. Any other state answers 409.
The question is stored as an `AGENT` comment. Agent token, loopback or admin session.

Resolves a ticket with `solution=WONT_DO`. Only allowed when the status is not `DONE` and the owner is `HUMAN`, else 409.
An optional `comment` is stored as a `HUMAN` comment. Admin session only.

post.summary: Hand a ticket to the AI
post.description: Only from `DEFINITION`, else 409. Sets owner `AI` and status `TODO`. Admin session only.

Appends a comment, author defaults to `HUMAN`. `handBackToAi` needs an `ON_HOLD` + `HUMAN` ticket, else 409.
Answers 403 when `author=AGENT` comes with an authenticated session cookie, also on loopback. Only an agent token or loopback without a session may post as `AGENT`.
Agent token, loopback or admin session.

get.description:
Job `solve-tasks`. Skips when a run is already `RUNNING` or no agent task is `OPEN`.
Auth: `CRON_SECRET` bearer or admin session. A wrong `CRON_SECRET` falls
through to the session check. A non-admin session answers 401, not 403.
Always answers 200 with the run, also when the run was skipped or the
GitHub dispatch failed (then `status` is `SKIPPED` or `FAILED`).

Job `solve-github-issues`. Skips when a run is already `RUNNING`.
Auth: `CRON_SECRET` bearer or admin session. A wrong `CRON_SECRET` falls
through to the session check. A non-admin session answers 401, not 403.
Always answers 200 with the run, also when the run was skipped or the
GitHub dispatch failed (then `status` is `SKIPPED` or `FAILED`).

post.summary: Report the result of a run
post.description:
Called by the GitHub workflow when it finishes. Sets status, counts and run URL.
A wrong agent token never falls through to a session: it answers 401.

get.description: Optional exact-match `job` filter. An empty `job` means no filter.
Every job with its newest run. `lastRun` is null when it never ran.

sessionCookie.name: JSESSIONID
sessionCookie.description:
Session cookie set by `POST /auth/login`. Scope `ADMIN` in a security
requirement means the session user must hold the role ADMIN
(`requireRole('ADMIN')`); a missing or wrong role answers 403.

agentBearer.description:
Agent token (`AGENT_API_TOKEN`) as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Checked before `X-Agent-Token`. A wrong token answers 401 and never
falls through to the session.

cronBearer.description:
Cron secret (`CRON_SECRET`) as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`.
A wrong secret falls through to the admin session check.

ErrorResponse.description:
Every error answer (4xx and 5xx), built by `middleware/errorHandler.ts`.
`fieldErrors` is empty except for input errors.

status.description: HTTP status code, repeated in the body.

message.description: German top-level message, for example `Validierungsfehler` or `Firma mit ID 99 nicht gefunden`.

timestamp.description: Server time, ISO-8601 with milliseconds and no `Z` suffix, for example `2026-04-15T10:30:00.123`.

fieldErrors.description: Field name (dot path inside the body, path parameter name, or `_` for the whole body) mapped to a German text.

PageMeta.description:
Paging fields of every page answer (Spring Data Page shape).
Page schemas combine it with `allOf` and `unevaluatedProperties: false`.

totalElements.description: Number of rows across all pages.

size.description: Page size used for this answer.

EmptyObject.description:
An object with no declared properties. As a request body, extra fields
are stripped and ignored. As an answer, the server sends `{}`.

timestamp.description: Server time, ISO-8601 UTC with `Z` (`new Date().toISOString()`).

LoginRequest.description:
Credentials. Both fields are optional in the contract: the route is not
validated by the contract (`x-skip-request-validation`). A missing or empty
field answers 401 `Ungültige Anmeldedaten`, not 400.

LoginResponse.description: The logged-in user (short form). The session id travels in the `Set-Cookie` header.

permissions.description: Listed on the user but not enforced by any middleware.

TestLoginRequest.description:
Test login by name only, no password. A missing or empty `benutzername`
answers 401 `benutzername required`.

Rolle.description: Role, the name from `users.ts` with the prefix `ROLE_`.

Permission.description: Permission on a user. Informational only.

Create or replace a scenario. `name` must be unique (409 otherwise).
Each process needs exactly N work durations and N-1 wait durations.
Durations are whole minutes from 0 to 479520 (999 days).

metadata.description: Free text, usually a JSON string.

pickedUpAt.description: ISO-8601 time of the claim or start.

ticketId.description: Id of the newest ticket that links to this task, or null.

solution.description: Set when the ticket is resolved (`DONE` column), else null.

pickedUpAt.description: ISO-8601 text. Set when an agent claims the ticket.

resolvedAt.description: ISO-8601 text. Set when the ticket is resolved.

fullyReady.description: Marker "ready to build without further human input". Stored as 0/1.

agentTaskId.description: Linked agent task (feedback item) that spawned the ticket.

solution.description: Set when the ticket is resolved (`DONE` column), else null.

TicketBoard.description: Tickets grouped by status, each column oldest first (`createdAt` ascending).

TicketSummary.description: Counts per enum value. Every key is always present (zero when empty).

TicketComment.description: One comment of a ticket thread.

agentTaskId.description: Must name an existing agent task, else 400 with a field error on `agentTaskId`.

comment.description: Closing comment, stored as an `AGENT` comment.
Closing comment, stored as a `HUMAN` comment.

handBackToAi.description: Moves the ticket to `TODO`, owner `AI`. Only allowed on `ON_HOLD` + `HUMAN` tickets, else 409.

author.description: Default `HUMAN`. `AGENT` is rejected with 403 when the request carries an authenticated session.

IdPath.name: id
IdPath.description: Record id, a positive whole number without sign or leading zeros.

FirmaIdPath.name: firmaId
FirmaIdPath.description: Company id, a positive whole number without sign or leading zeros.

PageQuery.name: page
PageQuery.description: Page number, 0-indexed. A missing, negative or non-numeric value falls back to 0.

SizeQuery.name: size
SizeQuery.description: Page size. Default 10. Values above 200 are capped at 200. A missing, non-positive or non-numeric value falls back to 10.

SortQuery.name: sort
SortQuery.description:
field,direction; direction in any case (asc/ASC/desc/DESC).
The allowed fields are the operation's `x-sort-fields`; the default is its
`x-default-sort`. An unknown field answers 400 with the message
`Ungültiges Sortierfeld: <field>`. A missing or unknown direction falls
back to the default direction.

SearchQuery.name: search
SearchQuery.description: Case-insensitive substring filter. The operation description names the matched field.

BadRequest.description: Invalid input. `message` names the problem; `fieldErrors` maps fields to German texts.

Unauthorized.description: Not authenticated (no session, or a missing or wrong token).

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but the role is not allowed (`Zugriff verweigert`).

Conflict.description: Conflict with the current data, for example a duplicate name or an invalid state change.
